title: AgentRunReceipt
description: Mandatory PROVENANCE of one agent run: which harness ran which agent profile for which product/tenant, the input/output content hashes (so the proposed artifacts are tamper-evident and de-duplicable), the tools/skills actually used, the sandbox + memory policies enforced, the secret REFERENCES used (env://<NAME> only — NEVER secret values), policy_checks booleans, and start/complete timestamps. The receipt records WHAT WAS DONE; it never asserts the agent output is true. No raw secrets — hashes, env:// refs, and check booleans only.

product_id.description: owning product that submitted the run

harness_provider.description: the agent-runtime/harness that ran (candidate runtime ids are recorded even when unavailable)

agent_profile_id.description: the agent profile/persona that was run

input_hash.description: canonical hash of the run input (tamper-evident; not the raw input)

output_hash.description: canonical hash of the agent output (tamper-evident; not the raw output)

tools_used.description: ids of tools the agent actually invoked (subset of the request allowlist)

skills_loaded.description: ids of skills loaded during the run

secret_refs_used.description: secret REFERENCES the run resolved, each an env://<NAME> handle — NEVER a secret value; resolved only at the runtime boundary

sandbox_policy.description: the AgentSandboxPolicy that was enforced for this run (recorded for audit)

memory_policy.description: the AgentMemoryPolicy that was enforced for this run (cross_tenant always false)

policy_checks.description: the governance checks enforced, e.g. {tools_allowlisted, no_forbidden_tool_used, sandbox_enforced, secrets_refs_only, no_cross_tenant_memory, steps_bounded, timeout_enforced} -> booleans
